I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed: cards and the win banner now respect reduced motion, including setting changes during play. Normal animations and gameplay remain intact.

Build, type checks, and 141 unit tests passed. All 79 browser checks passed, with one artwork timeout passing on isolated retry. Changed files pass formatting; 13 unrelated files have existing formatting issues.
